case_number: 2025 INSC 418; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 4560-4563 OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (C) Nos. 11779 – 11782 of 2022)
summary: Share valuation dispute; enhanced valuation confirmed at Rs.640/- per share; interest rate determination on 50-year delay; standard: reasonable compensation for time value of money; reliance on Tata Chemicals (interest as inherent right), FCI v. Coromandal Sacks (interest as capital accretion), Vaz v. Karnataka (inflation impact on delayed payment); High Court's 5% interest rate upheld; impugned orders modified.
legal_provisions_cited: Union of India v. Tata Chemicals Ltd
Fertilizer Corporation of India Ltd v. Coromandal Sacks Private Ltd
Bernard Francis Joseph Vaz v. Government of Karnataka
final_judgment: Appeal allowed with modification; interest rate fixed at 5% per annum; High Court orders affirmed as corrected.
